source: LAIT (Ferstler et al. 2026, arXiv:2606.26040, github.com/Yves575/lait): the four reading judges on all 772 versions of the 386 evaluation passages (published human and machine translation), mean and population sd; 2026-11-11
formula: reading = -(z(E)+z(F1)+z(F2)+z(M))/4; E excludes punctuation+grammar fixes, F1/F2 exclude mechanics

copyedit.definition: editor punctuation+grammar fixes per 100 words, mean of two runs

zero: 0 = the average LAIT passage, human and machine pooled; higher reads better
